summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Lume Veritas. Added and executed 6 new pytest tests for POST /api/explain (IT, EN, cache, empty word, whitespace-only, over-length). All 23 backend tests PASS (100%). Frontend Playwright covered: home load, briefings render with 196 word-buttons, word-popover opens on click and shows real Gemini explanation ('Carbonio indica anidride carbonica…'), registration, /ask flow returns real answer with 124 word-buttons wrapped in ClickableText, DeepDiveSheet opens with 184 word-buttons and NO Radix 'Missing Description' warning (SheetDescription sr-only present). Save buttons render for authenticated user. All new features + all previous fixes verified working. No blocking issues.
critical_code_review_comments: ClickableText tokenizer regex matches words of length >= 3 (first char + {2,}); short words like 'AI', 'il', 'la' remain plain text — intended behavior for 'significant words'.

WordPopover.onOpen resets fetched.current only on error, so an explanation successfully fetched once is cached in state; good UX. Cache also lives server-side via db.explanations upsert on {language:word.lower()}.
Ask retry (data-testid='ask-retry-btn') simply increments `attempt` which is in useEffect deps; correctly re-triggers request. Verified selectors present in code.

llm_text catches 429/rate/concurrent/limit substrings — reasonable heuristic; converts to friendly HTTP 429. Could tighten by inspecting exception type from emergentintegrations but string match is acceptable.
Consider adding a min-length guard for very short selections in /explain (currently only empty and >120 are rejected); a 1-char input like 'x' would still hit the LLM.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested critical flows (home, word-popover, register, ask+ClickableText, deep-dive+ClickableText+a11y, save button render)

test_credentials: Created dynamic test user during Playwright run (email test+<ts>@lume.dev / LumeTest2026!). Backend tests also create per-run unique users.
seed_data_creation: None — cache/persistence tested against live briefings from Gemini.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is a full regression suite (23 tests) covering root, topics, auth (register/login/me/preferences), briefing IT/EN + cache, deep-dive, ask, saved add/list/delete + auth guards, and NEW explain (IT/EN/cache/400 validation). Rate-limit test not directly forced; llm_text() handler covered by code inspection + verified all AI calls (briefing, deep-dive, ask, explain) returned 200 during this run. External URL: https://niche-news-1.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in iteration 2. Previous iteration's three fixes (429 handling in llm_text, ask-error+ask-retry-btn on AskPage, SheetDescription in DeepDiveSheet) are all present and functioning as intended.
